subject: Tenant attribute ownership & SCIM delta + redaction guidance
messages:
From: Zoe Park <zoe.park@trustaudits.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 16:08:00 -0400
Subject: Tenant attribute ownership, SCIM delta and redaction – initial intake

Hi Tessa / Priyom / Jordan,

Thanks for taking this — TileCorp's SIG assessment team has a couple of focused asks on access-control artifacts that we're hoping Redwood can provide by EOD 6/16 if possible. We want minimal scope: evidence for how tenant-level attributes are owned, how SCIM deltas are emitted (format + fields), and an example of how PII attributes are redacted for exported traces. Specifically:

- A mapping that shows attribute -> owner (e.g., user.email -> tenant-owner or system) for all top-level SCIM attributes you sync to customers.
- A SCIM delta export (sample CSV or JSON) showing add/update/remove events over a 7-day window — include the attribute names and timestamps.
- A short statement on retention and redaction policy for personally identifiable attributes surfaced in SCIM and SAML assertion samples (how long raw attribute values are retained, what is redacted in delivered audit artifacts).

Attachments are fine as stubs; we just need representative files we can reference in the SIG. If you have a one-pager that summarizes ownership/responsibility and the redaction rules that would be perfect.

If EOD 6/16 is tight, tell us the soonest you can deliver and whether you need a narrowing of scope (we can accept a tenant-scoped sample rather than full multi-tenant dumps).

Thanks,
Zoe Park
Senior Auditor – TrustAudits
zoe.park@trustaudits.com

--
Attachment: tile_svc_request_template.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Zoe Park <zoe.park@trustaudits.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Tenant attribute ownership, SCIM delta and redaction – initial intake

Hi Zoe,

Appreciate the clear scope. We can deliver a tenant-scoped bundle by 6/16 EOD. Quick clarifying questions so we give you exactly what you need: 

1) For the "attribute -> owner" mapping, do you want the ownership column to reference Redwood teams (e.g., Identity Platform, Product) or tenant-assigned owners (tenant-admin roles)? We can provide both but that will add time.

2) For the SCIM delta sample, are you ok with a CSV stub that includes the following columns: event_type, timestamp, user_id, attribute_name, old_value_redacted, new_value_redacted, actor? We will redact PII in-line (we can also provide an unredacted sample within a protected drive link if you confirm controls).

3) Redaction/retention: we currently retain raw attribute values in operational stores for 90 days for troubleshooting, and we maintain redacted exports for 365 days. Is the SIG team satisfied with a policy statement plus a redacted example, or do you need a sanitized raw extract under an NDA/secure link?

Proposed deliverables (by 6/16):
- attribute_owner_map.xlsx (tenant and team ownership columns)
- scim_delta_sample_20280612.csv (redacted values; includes event metadata)
- redaction_guidance_v1.pdf (one-page policy + examples)

If that works I will loop in Product Ops to pull the CSV and drop the items into a shared Drive link.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Security & Trust – Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0102

--
Attachment: none

From: Zoe Park <zoe.park@trustaudits.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: TileCorp Compliance <compliance@tilecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Tenant attribute ownership, SCIM delta and redaction – initial intake

Thanks Tessa — that proposed set is exactly what we typically accept. A couple of small clarifications: 

- Ownership column: tile's SIG reviewers prefer tenant-assigned owners where available, then the Redwood team as a fallback. If you can indicate both (tenant_owner / platform_owner) that's ideal but optional.
- For any unredacted raw extracts we will need a secure link and a short justification tied to a control point in the SIG (e.g., for troubleshooting within 72 hours of an incident). We do not need raw extracts for the standard review; redacted examples are fine.
- Redaction specifics: we usually ask that email addresses be tokenized (e.g., user+TID@example.com -> <tokenized>), device identifiers removed, and full names hashed or truncated. If you can add a quick mapping table in the PDF showing before/after that will help the review move faster.

If you can post the artifacts to the Drive folder and reply-all with links by 6/16 EOD we'll slot the materials into the SIG intake.

—Zoe

--
Attachment: tile_sig_scope.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Zoe Park <zoe.park@trustaudits.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Tenant attribute ownership, SCIM delta and redaction – delivery

Hi Zoe — delivering the tenant-scoped bundle for TileCorp in the Drive folder. Links and short notes below.

Drive (shared, restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleDriveLink
- scim_delta_sample_20280612.csv (redacted sample; columns: event_type,timestamp,user_id,attribute_name,old_value_redacted,new_value_redacted,actor). Example row: add,2028-06-10T14:22:03Z,usr_abc123,email,<redacted>,<redacted>,svc_sync
- attribute_owner_map.xlsx (columns: attribute,tenant_owner,platform_owner,notes). We flagged attributes that are tenant-managed vs platform-controlled.
- redaction_guidance_v1.pdf (one page with before/after examples: emails tokenized, names truncated to initials+hash, device ids removed).

We included a short statement in the PDF about retention: operational raw attribute values are retained in secure stores for 90 days for troubleshooting and audit purposes; redacted export artifacts persist for 365 days and are accessible to authorized compliance reviewers. Any request for unredacted extracts should be submitted with a business justification and will be delivered via a secure link for a limited window (documented in the access log).

Cc'ing Priyom and Jordan so they see the artifacts. Priyom: can you please confirm via reply if you want me to add the tenant-owner email column for any attributes where TileCorp has designated a steward? We can drop an updated XLSX into the same folder if you confirm.

Thanks — Tessa

--
